name: 神威·转移
description: 选择本棋子7格内1个其他友方棋子，将其传送至本棋子7格内1个空的可行走地格。
targetText: 7格内1个其他友方棋子，然后7格内1个空地格
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var ally = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 7, filter: 'ally' }); if (!ally || ally.needsTargetSelection) return ally; var pos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 7, filter: 'all' }); if (!pos || pos.needsTargetSelection) return pos; if (ally.instanceId === caster.instanceId || ally.ownerPlayerId !== caster.ownerPlayerId || Math.abs(ally.x-caster.x)+Math.abs(ally.y-caster.y)>7 || Math.abs(pos.x-caster.x)+Math.abs(pos.y-caster.y)>7) return { success: false, message: '神威转移目标不合法' }; if ((battle.extensions && battle.extensions.tileEffects || []).some(function(e) { return e.type === 'tails-flight-reservation' && e.x === pos.x && e.y === pos.y; })) return { success: false, message: '落点已被预留' }; var result = teleport(pos.x, pos.y, ally.instanceId); if (!result.success) return { success: false, message: '友军无法传送至该落点' }; return { success: true, message: caster.name + '将' + ally.name + '传送至(' + pos.x + ',' + pos.y + ')' }; }
